📖 Signal Legend — click to expand
Entry Signals (score 0–120, 20 pts each)
↑ BUY ≥60 pts
At least 3 of 6 entry conditions are met. This is the trigger to consider opening or adding to a position.
◉ WATCH 40–59 pts
2 of 6 conditions met — setup is forming but not ready. Monitor daily; may become a BUY.
— HOLD 0–39 pts
Fewer than 2 conditions met. No action — stock is not in an oversold dip. If you own it, keep holding.
The 6 entry rules (20 pts each):
R1 RSI(14) < 40 — stock is oversold on momentum
R2 MACD histogram < 0 but rising — selling pressure is easing
R3 Stochastic %K crosses above %D while both < 50 — early bullish flip
R4 Volume above 20-day average — buyers stepping in with conviction
R5 Price ≤ MA50 × 1.01 — stock is near or below its 50-day average (value zone)
R6 OBV (On-Balance Volume) rising — money flowing into the stock
Exit Signals (shown when you should consider selling)
↑ PROFIT TAKE
Stock has run up and is now overbought. RSI > 70 and falling, MACD histogram turning negative from above zero, or Stochastic doing a bearish cross from overbought. If you entered on a BUY signal and the stock has gained — this is your sell signal.
⬇ STOP LOSS
Price has broken below its 200-day moving average — the long-term trend has reversed. If you're holding a position, this is a hard exit to protect capital.
⚠ CAUTION
Momentum is weakening (MACD bearish, OBV falling, or price slipping below MA20 on volume) but the stock is not yet overbought. Not a sell signal by itself — watch closely for a PROFIT TAKE to follow.
Timeline Chart Colors
Green zone
BUY signal was active on those days — entry conditions were met.
Yellow zone
WATCH — setup was forming but not complete.
Grey zone
HOLD — no significant entry conditions active.
▼ Green triangle
PROFIT TAKE exit signal fired on that day.
▼ Red triangle
STOP LOSS exit signal fired — price broke below MA200.
▼ Yellow triangle
CAUTION exit signal fired — momentum weakening.
